# High Roller Technologies Inks Agreement with ProphetX to Expand Event Contracts Offering Through ROLR™


November 12, 2026 8:36 am EST[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_6e54525fa9c361e0a4143d4ba5ea28ae/highroller/news/2026-11-12_High_Roller_Technologies_Inks_Agreement_with_177.pdf)


*Planned integration intends to enable eligible ROLR customers to access ProphetX’s sports-focused exchange, supporting broader market choice and additional revenue opportunities*


LAS VEGAS, Nevada, Nov. 12, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) --[High Roller Technologies, Inc.](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=ILT-MblQZ-xHrZ-UqpWfk6u-bHP3R2OAsrMBFeFMDNVCW1aEMLIUEQyihIYcSWnVGm3h_bEPn-85mCEvtaL7CjkNYND98tcMGauhrmz6U0ukQ9JqdPd9IXQ0Lr0qi5Yn) (“High Roller” or the “Company”) (NYSE: ROLR), an online gaming and prediction markets company, today announced that its wholly owned subsidiary, ROLR FCM LLC, has entered into a definitive commercial agreement with ProphetX LLC (“ProphetX”) to integrate access to ProphetX’s federally regulated prediction markets exchange through a ROLR-branded interface.


“Expanding the markets available through ROLR is an important part of building a platform that traders choose to engage with,” said Seth Young, Chief Executive Officer of High Roller. “Our agreement with ProphetX combines additional sports markets with a revenue-sharing structure that allows ROLR to earn a portion of net fees generated by traders accessing ProphetX’s exchange through our interface. We believe this creates an attractive opportunity to generate an additional revenue stream by building on the ROLR brand, customer experience and marketing capabilities as we grow the business.”


“ROLR is building a prediction markets business around its brand, customer experience and distribution capabilities,” said Jake Benzaquen, Co-Founder and Chief Commercial Officer of ProphetX. “Our infrastructure gives partners a way to bring our event contracts directly into their products, while ProphetX handles the exchange and clearing functions. We look forward to working with High Roller to extend access to our markets through ROLR.”


**Agreement and Integration Highlights**


- **Expanded sports markets:** The planned integration is intended to give eligible ROLR customers access to additional sports event contracts on ProphetX, whose markets cover outcomes such as game results, player performance and season-long championships. Participants trade with one another at prices determined by buying and selling activity.
- **ROLR-branded experience:** Eligible users would be able to view ProphetX market data, submit orders electronically for execution on ProphetX’s exchange, and access and manage their ProphetX trading accounts through a ROLR-branded interface.
- **Regulated exchange infrastructure:** ProphetX is registered with the Commodity Futures Trading Commission (the “CFTC”) as both a designated contract market and a derivatives clearing organization, providing the infrastructure for trading, clearing and settlement.
- **Defined operating responsibilities:** ROLR would manage branding, marketing, customer acquisition and interface distribution. ProphetX would maintain customer trading accounts and funds and handle onboarding, identity verification, trade execution, clearing, settlement and market surveillance. Trading would remain subject to ProphetX’s rules and eligibility requirements.
- **Revenue participation:** ROLR would receive a share of net fees generated by users accessing ProphetX through the ROLR-branded interface, creating an additional potential revenue source.
- **Nonexclusive relationship:** The agreement provides flexibility for ROLR to continue expanding its offering through connections to other exchanges, subject to the agreement’s terms.
- **Timing and availability:** The agreement provides for an effective date six months after ROLR FCM LLC receives registration as a futures commission merchant, unless the parties mutually agree otherwise. ROLR FCM LLC has not yet received such registration, and there can be no assurance as to whether or when it will be obtained. Commercial availability will depend on completion of the integration, operational readiness and satisfaction of applicable regulatory requirements. A launch date has not been announced.


**I** **mportant Information**


ROLR FCM LLC is not currently registered as a futures commission merchant with the CFTC or a member of the National Futures Association, and the integration described in this press release will not be made available unless and until all applicable registrations, approvals and conditions have been obtained or satisfied. Access to event contracts will be subject to ProphetX’s rules and eligibility requirements and to applicable law, and may not be available to all persons or in all jurisdictions. Trading event contracts involves substantial risk, including the risk of loss of the entire amount committed to a position, and is not suitable for all participants

**About ProphetX**


Founded in 2018, ProphetX operates a U.S. prediction markets exchange and clearing organization registered with the CFTC. Built on a sports-focused foundation, its marketplace enables participants to trade event-based contracts at prices determined by market participants. ProphetX also provides infrastructure that enables other consumer platforms to integrate access to its markets. Its capabilities include a request-for-quote mechanism for pricing multi-event combinations. For more information, visit[http://www.prophetx.co/partners](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=enJbOPFp1YXv9ZZ8pCHgYVtwES5TvtKh6bE3TBo-YDQJt83reSHkDjavet0WwhXrCq5W1NslU1fDe_F8m5Fnd7RP3y-SYiO1N8QbxDgwBMrpIIjL9OBkXdbS6hQKxr2p) .
